01 / About

About me

Data engineering, database administration, and teaching.

I started in database administration and data analysis at the Central Election Commission of the Republic of Kosovo. I later taught at UBT and coordinated information systems. At Kosovo ICT Support, I trained people in Python, SQL, Big Data, and cloud technologies.

I now work as a Data Engineer at Raiffeisen Tech Kosovo / Raiffeisen Bank International. I develop ETL jobs, work with Databricks and AWS, and help keep data processing jobs running.

I'm looking for a remote role where I can use my engineering experience, work with teams, and explain technical issues clearly.
